
## 2024-10-16 - Todo List Accessibility & Empty State Improvements
**Learning:** Found a missing empty state pattern (`<h3>No hay tareas</h3>`) and missing ARIA labels on dynamic input fields (`Nombre de la nueva tarea`, `Marcar [tarea] como completada`). Added dynamic disabled states logic for forms where validation depends on reactive properties (`!newTask.label.trim()`). Corrected CSS text-decoration typo (`line-trought` to `line-through`).
**Action:** Always include empty states for lists generated by `v-for`, provide contextual screen-reader explanations for dynamic inline inputs like checkboxes, and disable submission buttons when required inputs are empty.
